biggest_catch: The $50 reward is only delivered as a digital Visa rewards card within 2-3 weeks after your friend completes a demanding 60-day qualification (DDs totaling $1,000 + 10 debit transactions).
catches: Referrer earns a $50 Visa Virtual Reward per qualified referral (checking or credit card).
Up to $500 in Visa Virtual Rewards per calendar year.

Friend requirements (checking): register via the referral link, open a new personal checking account (Affinity/Affinity Plus/Affinity Premier) within 180 days of registering, and within 60 days of opening make direct deposits totaling $1,000+ and complete 10 posted debit card transactions.
Friend requirements (credit card): register via the link and open a new Northwest credit card (friend earns $100).
The friend earns $400 for checking (or $100 for credit card) - more than the referrer.
Referrer must be an existing Northwest customer in good standing and register for the program.
Only one referrer per referred person.
Rewards valid 3 months from issuance; redeemed at internet, mail-order, telephone merchants.
Employees and affiliates are ineligible; can't be combined with other offers; offer subject to change or cancellation.

Share it with friends and family.
